name: Slovenia
intro: Prices are in euros, with a switch to see them in pounds, euros or US dollars. Prices checked October 2026; where a restaurant's price isn't shown yet, it's still to be added.
serviceText: Every figure is for one guest. Menu prices include VAT. Service is usually included, though some restaurants add a service charge; tipping is optional. Supplements such as caviar are left out. Prices shown in other currencies use the day's exchange rate and are approximate.
sourcesText: Dinner is the restaurant's main tasting menu, and wine is its wine pairing where one is offered. Prices come from each restaurant's own website and menus; restaurants that don't publish them are still to be priced.
starsText: The Google reviews score out of 5 and the number of reviews, checked in October 2026. Stars come from the latest MICHELIN Guide covering Slovenia.
introSl: Cene so v evrih, z gumbom za prikaz v funtih, evrih ali ameriških dolarjih. Cene preverjene oktobra 2026; kjer cena restavracije še ni prikazana, bo dodana.
serviceTextSl: Vsi zneski veljajo za enega gosta. Cene menijev vključujejo DDV. Postrežba je običajno vključena, čeprav nekatere restavracije dodajo postrežnino; napitnina je prostovoljna. Doplačila, na primer za kaviar, niso vključena. Cene v drugih valutah so preračunane po dnevnem tečaju in so približne.
sourcesTextSl: Večerja je glavni degustacijski meni restavracije, vino pa njegova vinska spremljava, če jo ponujajo. Cene so s spletnih strani in menijev restavracij; tiste, ki jih ne objavljajo, bodo dodane pozneje.
starsTextSl: Oceno Google (od 5) in število mnenj smo preverili oktobra 2026. Zvezdice so iz najnovejšega vodnika MICHELIN za Slovenijo.
